description: This file defines the GreaterThanOrEqualsOperator class, which implements comparison operators for filtering JSON API queries in SuiteCRM. It provides methods to get the filter tag and SQL operator, and validates operators.

classes.name: GreaterThanOrEqualsOperator
classes.description: Implements a 'greater than or equal to' comparison operator for JSON API filtering in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag 'gte' for use in JSON API filters.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator '>=' for database queries.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided operator string is valid for this operator, ensuring it's a string and then delegating validation to the parent.
